title: pp.dystort-st~
description: `pp.dystort-st~` provides stereo dynamic distortion and saturation, using an internal envelope follower to keep saturation consistent across different input intensities. Its Squeeze, Squash, and Squish controls respectively apply tanh soft clipping, add odd harmonics, and add even harmonics; the creation argument sets the anti-aliasing oversampling factor, which must be a power of two.
